backgrounds.name: Farming family
backgrounds.description: Your parents farm two acres of paddy and groundnut. Money arrives with the harvest and leaves long before the next one. The household runs on early mornings, shared work and a tin box of savings.
obligations: Help at home during harvest season
Your family hopes you'll contribute once you earn
opportunities: A family that shows up when it matters

backgrounds.name: City lower-middle-class family
backgrounds.summary: Every rupee counted, every plan written down.
backgrounds.description: Appa is a bus conductor; Amma runs a tailoring business from the front room. There is always a plan, and a notebook in which the plan is written. There is rarely money left over.
obligations: Household savings are already promised to repairs and relatives

backgrounds.name: Affluent family business
backgrounds.description: Your family runs a well-established textiles business. Fees are not a worry. Expectations are: relatives already talk about the day you'll 'take over'.
obligations: Family expects you to join the business one day
opportunities: Can afford private colleges and coaching

hometowns.name: Chennai
hometowns.description: Coastal metro: big job market, long commutes, filter coffee everywhere.

hometowns.name: Bengaluru
hometowns.description: Tech capital: highest salaries, highest rents, legendary traffic.

hometowns.name: Vellanur (Tiruvannamalai district)
hometowns.description: A fictional village two bus rides from town: low costs, fewer opportunities, everyone knows your name.

traits.name: Curious
traits.description: You learn faster when you're interested — which is often.

traits.name: Steady
traits.description: Habits stick to you. Discipline grows faster.

traits.name: Outgoing
traits.description: Conversations come easily; communication grows faster.

traits.name: Empathetic
traits.description: People feel heard around you. Bonds grow faster.

traits.name: Resilient
traits.description: You bounce back. Well-being recovers faster.

traits.name: Hands-on
traits.description: You learn by doing. Practical skills grow faster.

ambitions.name: Financial security
ambitions.description: Never again worry about the next month's rent.

ambitions.name: Mastery of a craft
ambitions.description: Become genuinely, quietly excellent at something.

ambitions.name: Family first
ambitions.description: Build a life your family can lean on — and enjoy.

ambitions.name: Build something of my own
ambitions.description: Own the thing you build, risks included.

ambitions.name: Serve my community
ambitions.description: Leave your street better than you found it.
